mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO ledger_detail (ledger_id, light_group_id, source_zone_id, target_zone_id) VALUES
(#{detail.ledgerId}, #{detail.lightGroupId}, #{detail.sourceZoneId}, #{detail.targetZoneId})
mapper.select: SELECT d.id, d.ledger_id, d.light_group_id, d.source_zone_id, d.target_zone_id, lg.group_code AS group_code, gz_src.zone_name AS source_zone_name, gz_tgt.zone_name AS target_zone_name, COALESCE(lg.archive_status, 'ACTIVE') AS archive_status FROM ledger_detail d LEFT JOIN light_group lg ON lg.id = d.light_group_id LEFT JOIN garage_zone gz_src ON gz_src.id = d.source_zone_id LEFT JOIN garage_zone gz_tgt ON gz_tgt.id = d.target_zone_id WHERE d.ledger_id = #{ledgerId} ORDER BY d.id ASC
